player_note: The description says: 'This deck helped me win my first major title, the Birmingham Grand Slam yesterday.' (posted 29 October 2000). The strategy says: 'I used it to win the B'Ham Grand Slam, and it went 3-0. It won by 27, something like 17 and one really close game against HD, I only won by 4.' A slightly weaker version lost only to Martin Akesson's Court flip at the DecipherCon team event.
